newsitem.title: USA: America Online blocks junk E-mail - NYT.
newsitem.headline: America Online blocks junk E-mail - NYT.

text.p: America Online Inc took the unusual step of blocking all incoming messages from five Internet sites it said were sending millions of unsolicited commercial messages over computer networks each week, The New York Times reported on Thursday.
America Online took the move on Wednesday in response to a torrent of complaints from subscribers who say electronic junk mail is clogging their computer in-boxes.
David Phillips, associate general counsel for the company, said the five Internet sites included three associated with a marketing company in Philadelphia called Cyber Promotions Inc.
The sites were responsible for sending as many as 700,000 unsolicited commercial messages each day to the private electronic mailboxes of more than a million America Online subscribers.

America Online's announcement of a crackdown on junk electronic mail is the most sweeping and public acknowledgement yet of problems arising from sending unsolicited advertisements over computer networks.
